description: Actual Iris custom biome registrations derived from customDerivitives in the Koikoi pack. This is distinct from the 403 Iris biome definition files: only customDerivitives receive iris.biome.<dimension>/<id> client names.

usage.translationKey: Use this key in resource-pack language JSON, for example assets/iris/lang/zh_cn.json: {"iris.biome.koikoi/tropical_plains":"热带平原"}.
usage.registryResource: Current Iris 4.3.x uses content-addressed minecraft:worldgen/biome resources such as iris:biomes/<sha256>. The translation key is the stable client-facing name; use the physical resource only when a datapack must target the generated registry resource.
usage.sourceDefinition: The Iris biome file and customDerivitives entry that authored the registration.
usage.duplicateIds: A few custom IDs occur in more than one definition. If physicalDefinitionCount is greater than one, the same client translation key is associated with multiple content-addressed resources.
usage.registryClientName: Iris registers a legacy client alias in the form iris:koikoi/<customBiomeId>; the observed Iris translation/display key is recorded as iris.biome.koikoi/<customBiomeId>.
